systems.system: Public Prosecution digital systems (criminal justice, family prosecution, traffic prosecution and civil status applications)
systems.owner: Public Prosecution, with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
systems.tiers: the Public Prosecutor says collaboration has extended to 118 police departments and criminal courts across several governorates; the ICT minister calls the prosecution system fully paperless; the protocol of 13 December 2025 adds 10 projects and aims to ease coordination with law enforcement agencies

systems.system: Digital reporting and statistics system of the Public Prosecution
systems.country_label: advanced digital reporting and statistics system
systems.tiers: named beside the 118 police departments and criminal courts, as giving crime analysis

systems.system: Law enforcement system, to be implemented digitally across all governorates
systems.tiers: the protocol plans to accelerate its full digital implementation across all governorates; what it does is not described

systems.system: Public Prosecution e-portal and services on the Digital Egypt platform
systems.platform: Digital Egypt portal and mobile application
systems.tiers: citizens and lawyers; digital services are 24% of all prosecution services

note: MCIT press release of 13 December 2025 on a protocol with the Public Prosecution. Every system described is the prosecution's; the link to 118 police departments is not described as stations making a record, and the 'law enforcement system' is named without saying what it does, so no fact for the record class.
